title: Weekend Garden
text:
Kasia is fifteen years old. She goes to school from Monday to Friday. After school, she likes to read books and listen to music. Her favorite book is about a girl who travels to the sea.

On Saturdays, Kasia helps her grandmother in the garden. They grow tomatoes and red flowers. Kasia says that gardening is relaxing. In the evening, she meets her friends at the cinema.

questions.text: Who does Kasia help on Saturdays?

options: Her friends make her do it

questions.text: What kind of person is Kasia most likely to be?

vocabulary.definition: the one that you like most
the mother of your mother or father
making you feel calm and rested
comes together with someone on purpose

paragraph_translations: Kasia ma piętnaście lat. Chodzi do szkoły od poniedziałku do piątku. Po szkole lubi czytać książki i słuchać muzyki. Jej ulubiona książka opowiada o dziewczynie, która podróżuje nad morze.
W soboty Kasia pomaga babci w ogrodzie. Razem hodują pomidory i czerwone kwiaty. Kasia mówi, że ogrodnictwo jest relaksujące. Wieczorem spotyka się z przyjaciółmi w kinie.
